notes.title: 📣 End of July Development Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45273512/d011b8eb10adb5ce9dfffbee767e0306372d2651.png"][/img]You are in February, morning, 8 degrees. Brrrrrrrr 🥶🥶🥶[/p][p][/p][h1]Hey everyone! 👋[/h1][p][b]First things first:[/b] If you haven’t already, please add Motocross The Game to your Steam wishlist: it’s super important for our visibility and really helps us grow![/p][h3]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3188660/Motocross_The_Game/"]Wishlist on Steam[/url] 👈[/h3][p]Thank you 🧡[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45273512/6ed175c9a8f4e9ae26e06555be9cd198f00c8add.png"][/img]Our artists are simply amazing...[/p][p][/p][h3]🚧 What’s new in July?[/h3][p]July has been full throttle for us, here’s what we’ve been up to:[/p][list][*][p]🏟️ Worked on a brand new track (almost ready for the next Alpha!)[/p][/*][*][p]🏍️ Kept improving the physics and collision systems[/p][/*][*][p]🎛️ Upgraded the HUD and replay HUD for a better experience[/p][/*][*][p]📸 Integrated [b]Photo Mode[/b]: capture your best moments with cool effects![/p][/*][*][p]👻 Enhanced the ghost system (race against yourself or friends!)[/p][/*][*][p]🤸 Improved rider animations for more realism and reactions to the physics[/p][/*][*][p]🎤 Recorded brand new sounds (some of you heard the sneak peek in #mtg-screenshots on [url="https://discord.gg/https://discord.gg/motocrossthegame"]Discord – join us[/url]!)[/p][/*][*][p]🚦 Integrated a new bike sound & rev limiter (still WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]🎶 Added different fresh in-game sounds from real life recordings[/p][/*][*][p]🚧 Rolled out the first version of off-track detection (WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]🏁 Integrated new racing logic on the next Alpha track[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ Added & improved UI elements (still WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 Made replay mode even better (WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]🦵 Added first version of leg simulation when stopping the bike[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ Added automatic shifting helper, traction control, anti-wheelie and anti-stoppie[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Lots of physics tweaking & general improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45273512/4f0247ac7adbc9dd9ec63dc8dc7f627e940140c4.png"][/img]FMX ramp testing... Getting ready for MTGX-Games 😅[/p][p][/p][h3]📅 What’s next?[/h3][p][b]August is going to be huge![/b] Three members of our team will be at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany from August 19th to 22nd! Come say hi at our booth and maybe get hands-on with the game! 🙌[/p][p]✨ Plus, we’re cooking up a big announcement for August... stay tuned! ✨[/p][p]Thanks again for your amazing support – we seriously can’t wait to show you what’s next! You all rock! 🤘[/p][p]— [i]The Motocross The Game team 🧡[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45273512/35b5e294268eaf15e5cb3edaeb294dcc734a269d.png"][/img][/p][p]Sending the finish line jump on the new test track![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45273512/be6ce06e72c3552fd5e050479dbe6812f445fc37.png"][/img][/p][p]A test with the photo mode using the manual focus: obviously not the best focus here! 😅[/p]
